specification.objective: Make Kanban menus appear immediately, restore the fast create-task affordance in each column header, square the per-column task counter, remove redundant drag guidance, and move synchronization status to the right side of the navbar while preserving the stable Kanban architecture and responsive behavior.

requirements.statement: Kanban project/type/parent selectors and card/column popup menus must open without transition delay by using an explicit no-animation menu mechanism instead of the current animated dropdown route behavior.
Each manageable Kanban column must expose a compact top-header action for creating a task/card, while retaining the existing explicit footer add action.
The per-column task count indicator must be square rather than pill-shaped.
The board header must remove the instructional drag text and keep only the information/actions that remain useful after the interaction is learned.
Synchronization state must appear once, on the right side of the accent navbar, and only that small status subtree may rebuild when mutation state changes.

The changes must preserve the current compact/responsive Kanban layout, raw-pointer drag model, server-authoritative persistence, loading skeletons, controller performance work, square TouchIn styling, and no-external-dependency constraint.

Stale widget tests from the previous Kanban UI increments must be updated to Flutter 3.47-compatible public assertions and the current drag/column-action affordances so the increment does not preserve known CI compilation/interaction failures.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Project and task editor selects use the reusable WorkspaceInstantSelectField backed by showMenu with AnimationStyle.noAnimation, and ProjectTaskEditorDialog no longer contains DropdownButtonFormField.
Every PopupMenuButton in ProjectKanbanBoard explicitly uses AnimationStyle.noAnimation.
The A fazer lane exposes an 'Adicionar card em A fazer' header control and opening it still reaches the shared task editor.
The keyed column counter renders at 22 by 22 logical pixels with no rounded pill radius.
The phrase 'Arraste pelo ícone para mover cards entre etapas.' is absent from the rendered board and production source.
The keyed navbar sync status renders 'Sincronizado' on the right and is driven by a narrow AnimatedBuilder bound to ProjectKanbanController; the board header no longer renders a duplicate sync chip.
Existing virtualization, drag implementation, loading skeleton, compact cards, responsive tests, API/controller files, pubspec and repository POLIS policy remain unchanged.

Editor tests inspect rendered InputDecorator decoration instead of the nonexistent TextFormField.decoration getter, and board interaction tests target drag_indicator_rounded plus the current column popup-menu reorder flow.

invariants.statement: Backend/API contracts, optimistic concurrency, server-authoritative mutation sequencing, conflict reload behavior, task/card identity, permissions and controller state semantics do not change.
ProjectKanbanBoard continues to use fixed-extent slivers, persistent scroll controllers, Listener raw-pointer drag handling, repaint isolation and bounded cache extents.
No dependency, pubspec, theme-global, renderer/bootstrap, CI or .polis/policy.json change is introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: A Kanban dropdown/menu retains a default 300ms popup transition or an equivalent artificial opening delay.
Restoring the top create-task affordance removes or changes the existing footer 'Adicionar card' action.
Synchronization status is duplicated in both navbar and board header.
The UX change reintroduces external drag/drop packages, Flutter Draggable/DragTarget/ReorderableListView, optimistic local persistence, or broad page rebuilds.

inputs.statement: Current project/task selectors use DropdownButtonFormField and board column/card actions use PopupMenuButton default popup transitions.
Current lane header lacks a create-card action, its card count is pill-shaped, the board header shows drag instructions, and sync status is rendered inside the board.

GitHub CI run 183 for baseline commit 5d916b2 is red because prior UI tests use the nonexistent TextFormField.decoration getter on Flutter 3.47.5 and older drag/column-action finders; these are test-regression defects, not evidence that the current production UI is broken.

outputs.statement: Reusable instant square select field used by the Kanban project selector and shared task editor.
Immediate board action menus, restored lane-header add-task button, square counters and simplified board header.
Single compact synchronization status on the navbar's right side with isolated rebuild scope.
Widget regression tests aligned with Flutter 3.47 public widgets and the current Kanban interaction controls.

failure_semantics.statement: With only the focused regression test installed on the baseline, the regression command exits 1 and prints kanban_instant_menu_ux_missing.
Any Flutter compile/widget/layout failure remains authoritative; Flutter is unavailable in the packaging environment and therefore those tests must not be represented as locally executed.
If an instant menu cannot resolve a valid render anchor, it returns without opening rather than using guessed coordinates or mutating selection.
